correctness.rationale: Eight equations obtained by explicit derivation composition; open fibers affine two-planes and punctured plane base; zero-constant locus has c*u=b² with rank-one kernel, producing exact counts. Explicit deformations of both rank-one and rank-zero boundary linear parts into the open closure establish irreducibility. Rationality follows from a rational affine-plane bundle on a dense chart. Exhaustive q=2,4 verifier independently confirms every equation via basis actions and point counts; finite tests not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The height-one restricted nilpotent cone is a standard natural geometric invariant connected to modular Lie theory; this treats the excluded exceptional prime for the first two-generator truncated Witt example. It gives both complete irreducibility/rationality classification and a uniform point-count polynomial over every finite extension, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The boundary argument identifies how square-zero derivations with vanishing constants arise in the closure.
